kind.description: How the objective is decided. Omitted means defeatAllOpponents. 'surviveRounds' is satisfied the moment the authored round completes, and failed when the objective's own side has nobody left in the battle.

side.description: The side the objective belongs to. Satisfying it favours that side.

targetPlacementId.description: Encounter placement the objective is about. Required by defeatTarget and protectTarget.

rounds.description: How many rounds a surviveRounds objective is about. A round is one pass through the turn order: everybody still standing having acted under sideBlocks and initiative, and one turn for each side under alternating. Required by surviveRounds and refused on every other kind, because a count nothing can read is a number an author meant something by.
